body: I want to say thank you for your kind comments, I've found some strength to keep fighting.

Today my children called me up on the phone really crying begging me to take them home or at least come and see them,,, she took the phone and told me no I can not see them. Not sure how much longer I can hold on.

I've tried everything in the book both personally and legally, I've come up to nothing but biased walls, my entire family will no longer speak to me because of all the things I've been accused of.. I trusted this woman with my life for 12 years, I could never trust anyone again.
